name: Naitou Tooru
source: The main protagonist, a second-year high school student. He suffers from having lucid dreams every night because of a past accident, and relies on his childhood friend [url=/c11597]Saki[/url] and his glasses to tell dreams apart from reality. He lives away from his parents in a house which is owned by Saki's parents.
